rachel-sales: SolarWave exec asked for an EOW unblock. Main blockers: SSO (SAML+SCIM), EU-only pilot isolation, and a one-off pilot discount ask. Need an exec-ready one-pager.

tom-se: We support SAML (SP & IdP). For immediate test we need IdP metadata + 2 test accounts + their allowlist entry for our EU test IPs. We can enable an EU feature-flagged SP.

kevin-cs: From CS: customer insists logs/transcripts stay in EU during pilot and wants 30-day retention. Also requests a technical owner for the pilot.

nina-infra: EU-only Dedicated pilot is possible but requires reserved nodes. Lead time ~72h after approval. Estimated infra cost: E2,800/week. Will open ticket after legal confirms concession path.

priya-legal: Any concession >20% needs Deal Desk + VP signoff. Post ARR and exact pilot term here and I'll route for expedited review.

olga-cust: SolarWave security - we can provide metadata today and prefer default SCIM attributes (email, name, groups). We can defer custom attrs.

rachel-sales: ARR estimate for enterprise path: E2,5 00k. Pilot term proposed: 4 weeks. Customer asks for 25% off pilot fees.

priya-legal: Noted. I'll prepare a short amendment template while routing to Deal Desk. Please attach ARR and pilot term in this thread (copy the numbers above).

tom-se: Quick test plan:
```
1) Upload IdP metadata to our SP (EU test endpoint)
2) SP-initiated login with 2 test users
3) SCIM sync check (email, name, groups)
4) Confirm access control via groups
```

kevin-cs: I'll be the technical owner for SolarWave during pilot. Will coordinate schedule.

sre-bot: infra-ticket created DP-9991 by nina-infra  Dedicated pilot queued, est provisioning 72h after approval.

nina-infra: If Deal Desk approves the concession, I'll switch the ticket to expedited and start provisioning immediately.

rachel-sales: Next steps: 1) SolarWave posts IdP metadata + test accounts (olga-cust) 2) Priya routes concession to Deal Desk 3) Nina confirms cost & provisioning 4) Tom books SAML test window. Aim: decision by Fri COB.

olga-cust: We'll post metadata + two test users by EOD today.

tom-se: Ack, I can run tests tomorrow morning CET once metadata is up.

priya-legal: Deal Desk pinged. Will update here when VP approves or requests more info.

rachel-sales: I'll prepare the 1-pager for execs and drop it here in the next 2 hours. Keep flags raised here if anything blocks.
